repos.name: avd-current-state
repos.status: Read-only PowerShell collector, validator, and redacted C11 facts snapshot across all five control planes.
repos.backlog: Add -Cloud usgov support (C26), signed collector release, and unified endpoint probe map.

repos.name: avd-assess
repos.status: Open AVD assessment methodology across five control planes, pinned sources, and C25/C26 contracts.
repos.backlog: Expand GCC High checks (C26), benchmark corpus coverage, and sovereign pin verification.

repos.name: avd-migrate
repos.status: Offline single-pool C14 baseline designer and manifest writer portal at avd-ops.app/migrate/.
repos.backlog: Optional LZA .bicepparam starter export and multi-pool migration planning.

repos.name: avd-landing-zone
repos.status: Top-level orchestrator and deployment portal at avd-ops.app/deploy/ across the control-plane repos.
repos.backlog: Azure US Government & GCC High orchestration (C26), autoscale power-role validation, and Private Link NSG guards.

repos.name: avd-entra
repos.status: Declarative Microsoft Graph templates and Cloud Shell scripts for AVD groups, Conditional Access, and Entra Kerberos.
repos.backlog: Validate greenfield and brownfield Entra Kerberos flows and sovereign cloud endpoints.

repos.name: avd-intune
repos.status: Intune policy-as-code, assignment filters, session-host MDM enrollment, and Windows 365 Cloud PC profiles.
repos.backlog: Expand baseline policy packs, drift detection, and Windows 365 Cloud PC parity.

repos.name: avd-m365
repos.status: Greenfield Microsoft 365, OneDrive Known Folder Move, and Teams VDI optimization control plane.
repos.backlog: Add Teams VDI optimization verification and automated M365 tenant readiness checks.

repos.name: avd-azure
repos.status: Cloud-native Azure Bicep engine for AVD host pools, workspaces, FSLogix Azure Files, and Private Link.
repos.backlog: Sovereign cloud parameters, GPU session host SKU templates, and nested Azure Local lab support.

repos.name: avd-hcl
repos.status: Enterprise IaC path for native AVD infrastructure alongside the Bicep orchestrator.
repos.backlog: Align module outputs with shared contracts and add end-to-end lab validation.

repos.name: avd-networking
repos.status: Platform Connectivity hub VNet, Azure Firewall, central Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, gateways, and Bastion.
repos.backlog: AVD Private Link NSG port rules, hub-peered bypass routes, and multi-region hub templates.

repos.name: avd-power-platform
repos.status: Power Platform governance, DLP policies, and approval-gated Power Automate day-2 workflows.
repos.backlog: Expand self-service access flows and day-2 host lifecycle automation.

repos.name: avd-swarm
repos.status: Desktop DevOps agents across AVD, Windows 365, and Intune; S1a spike runs with human-gated write design.
repos.backlog: Wire external executor plumbing, approval gates, and helpdesk ticket adapter (ADR 0027).

repos.name: avd-second-brain
repos.status: Desktop DevOps knowledge base, contract registry, and cross-repo docs consistency checks.
repos.backlog: Add C26 cloud registry, sovereign workload placement rules, and automated freshness sweeps.

repos.name: avd-benchmark
repos.status: Tier 1 synthetic benchmark harness (storage, logon storm, density, autoscale, BCDR) and C25 explorer.
repos.backlog: FlaUI workload engine, automated Tier 1 run evidence, and expanded explorer comparisons.

repos.name: avd-remediate
repos.status: 5-step guided troubleshooting portal, read-only diagnostic probes, and human-gated remediation workbench.
repos.backlog: Expand host telemetry collectors, BYO-LLM diagnostic adapters, and remediation runbooks.

repos.name: avd-linecheck
repos.status: End-user browser network check portal at avd-ops.app/linecheck/ measuring latency and endpoint reachability.
repos.backlog: Companion local log-bundle script and unified probe map shared with avd-current-state.

repos.name: avd-learn
repos.status: Ground-up AVD foundations dataset, CLI, and installable PWA mapped to AZ-104 and AZ-140.
repos.backlog: Expand interactive lab scenarios, AZ-140 study modules, and cross-links to avd-ops standards.

repos.name: avd-ops
repos.status: Front-door site (avd-ops.dev), standards library, security review, architecture diagrams, and onboarding docs.
repos.backlog: Automated issue-board sync, operator walkthroughs, and cross-repo roadmap coverage.
